card.fact_statement: The Zhuhai Sports Center issued a notice suspending operations at around 9 p.m. following the attack.
card.source_span: The Zhuhai Sports Center issued a notice at around 9 p.m. on 11 November

target_qa_variants.question: Ni saa ngapi Kituo cha Michezo cha Zhuhai kilitoa ilani ya kusitisha shughuli kufuatia shambulio la gari la Zhuhai la 2024?
target_qa_variants.source_span: The Zhuhai Sports Center issued a notice at around 9 p.m. on 11 November
target_qa_variants.translation_note: 9 p.m. translates to 'saa tatu usiku' in standard Swahili time.

backtranslation_en.question: At what time did the Zhuhai Sports Center issue a notice to suspend operations following the 2024 Zhuhai car attack?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The target language QA accurately translates the question and the expected answer (using the correct Swahili time convention for 9 p.m.).
